description: Thread dump (jstack -l). Default: plain text. Set structured=true for JSON lock-wait chains (live snapshot). Historical contention: profile_jfr_locks. Deadlock cycle: check_deadlock.

pid.description: Process ID of the Java application. Get this from list_java_processes.

structured.description: Return structured JSON with lockWaitChains instead of plain-text dump. Default: false.

topN.description: Maximum number of threads to include in the output. Default: 10. Increase for applications with many threads.

name: analyze_threads
